project: ChefZC personal website — 川流不息 / Everything in flow
brief: An expressive, youthful dopamine portfolio whose flowing forms, typography, relationships and returns express continuity and causality. Preserve every existing work, note, record, source and asset.

theme.name: 川流不息
theme.statement: 万物流动不止，世间万物皆有轮回因果。
theme.signature: Offset Chinese theme lettering, interlocking sculptural currents, a continuous river spine and a navigable flow index.

platform: Existing static HTML / ESM JavaScript / CSS / esbuild; embedded apps keep their own interfaces.

sourceOfTruth.content: Existing project, post, music and research records; exact decorative revisions tracked in flow-authorized-art-revision.json, retired raster hash protected in the design archive.
sourceOfTruth.catalogue: dist/site-catalog.js + existing project and post records

scope: Personal profile and all original sections
Gallery and its four collection rooms
New flow index with 40 real destinations

layout.composition: Subject-led asymmetry; wide identity typography; flowing sculptural material; calm reading and direct controls.
layout.phone: Recompose text and sculpture into a vertical flow; all primary navigation remains visible. Reading panels use comfortable insets; metrics become compact rows and the model ring separates from its legend below 600px.

typography.family: Noto Sans SC with readable system fallback

stateInvariants: One shared language and motion preference across owned pages.
The current project identity is reflected in a shareable URL.
Browser Back closes a project view before leaving the collection.
Article return links point to the original stable card.
Changing language retains the selected Atlas plate.
Empty search and invalid project links have a working recovery path.
Copy transactions cannot publish stale feedback after language changes.
All collection rooms derive the main count from the actual project array.

motion.ambient: 9-second sculptural breathing, flowing SVG traces, context-specific existing exhibit motion and native navigation transitions.
motion.interaction: One critically damped controller owns sculpture inspection and pointer pose; target changes retain position and velocity.
motion.pause: Shared OS/manual preference; background/offscreen suspension; full settled content in reduced motion.
motion.build: Shared Three.js engine chunks; canonical imports for language, motion and shared chrome.

review.kind: One-agent simulated review across nine perspectives; no independent experts or numerical award scores claimed.

limitations: No Awwwards submission or award result claimed; the 2026-10-08 publication is tracked separately in flow-publication-verification.json.
Browser viewport emulation is not physical phone or Safari evidence.
Physical touch, screen-reader output, forced colours, 200% text zoom and hardware Web Vitals remain unverified.
QQ Music playback permissions remain platform-dependent.
Editable deliverables are local SVG/CSS/JS and specifications; no Figma/Illustrator cloud files created.
